entries.f7f464cfa4bc3b8e: Leveraging the geographical advantage of its business base, Fushiki Port, Fushiki Outer Port Manyo Wharf and Toyama New Port, which are located at the center of the economic zone around the Sea of Japan, the company states that it will promote physical and human exchange with countries across the sea. In its core port transport business, the company, citing a sense of crisis that competition will intensify due to deregulation at regional ports, states that it will work to reduce costs while enhancing its services by drawing on comprehensive logistics know-how. As issues to address, the company cites expanding cargo and shipping routes at Fushiki-Toyama Port, focusing on modal shift in Japan, and improving operational efficiency and transforming its business through the use of digital technology and generative AI.
